newsitem.title: USA: Senior U.S. Democrat sees budget amendment defeat.
newsitem.headline: Senior U.S. Democrat sees budget amendment defeat.

text.p: Senate Deputy Democratic Whip John Breaux, a supporter of the balanced budget constitutional amendment, said Wednesday he expects the amendment will fail by one vote.

Speaking to reporters, Breaux of Louisiana said he expects New Jersey Democratic Sen. Robert Torricelli, the key undecided senator, to vote against the amendment. "He's a 'no'," Breaux said of Torricelli.
Torricelli is to announce his decision later Wednesday. Without his vote, the amendment will be one vote shy of the 67 needed to pass. "It doesn't pass by one vote," Breaux said.
